headline: 27B at IQ2_S (MTP build) on a 12 GB 3080 Ti — FINAL VERIFIED STATE: single slot, 29,184 context, Q8_0 KV cache, all 63 layers forced to GPU (n_gpu_layers=63). Measured 10,725 / 12,288 MiB on the card → it FITS fully on the GPU, no CPU spill. (Earlier notes claiming 'spills to CPU' were WRONG — they assumed f16 KV and ignored the user's Q8_0 KV setting.) Every number below was read from the live machine (nvidia-smi / lms ps / llama.cpp log) or is an explicit observation.
hardware: box strata (retired Oct 2026): RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB for this run (llama-server via LM Studio ); same box's Intel Arc B70 ran the benchmark reference model on
facts: Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-IQ2_S-mtp.gguf — the MTP (multi-token-prediction) build, 8.95 GiB on disk. (NOT the plain iq2_s.)
1 (fixed — was 2, which doubled the KV cache and caused two concurrent llama-server processes)
Q8_0 (user setting) — halves the f16 KV memory
n_gpu_layers = 63 (ALL layers on GPU, hard-forced by user; llama.cpp log: 'failed to fit params to free device memory: n_gpu_layers already set by user to 63, abort')
10,725 / 12,288 MiB — FITS the 12 GB card with ~1.5 GiB headroom; 27 GiB system RAM free → no CPU offload at this config
~0% util, ~11 W (idle sample, not under load)
llama-server PID 2040 on the Arc B70 is still running the benchmark's OWN reference model (Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M) on  — same box. Does not touch the 3080 but shares CPU/RAM/PCIe.

16K ≈ 31.5 tok/s (speed test) · 48K (Q8 KV) ≈ 4.6 tok/s · 64K ≈ 3.9 tok/s · games @16K ≈ 23 tok/s. NOTE: the 48K/64K slow runs predate the Q8-KV + single-slot config, so they are NOT comparable to the current setup.
NOT yet measured at 29K + PAR 1 + Q8 KV. Needs a fresh speed test to anchor the record.

observations.text: GPU and CPU both finished loading at the same time → model spans both.
observations.status: TRUE for the earlier PARALLEL-2 + f16-KV config (2 KV caches + f16 pushed past the card). RESOLVED after reload to PAR 1 + Q8 KV + forced 63 GPU layers: now fits on the GPU alone (10.7 GiB).

observations.text: 'you keep forgetting i have quantized the kv cache.'
observations.status: ACKNOWLEDGED — Q8_0 KV halves the KV memory and is what makes 29K fit. Earlier spill math was wrong for ignoring it.

observations.text: 'it looks like you have loaded the model twice.'
observations.status: CONFIRMED — was PARALLEL 2 (two llama-server processes, two KV caches). User ejected and reloaded to PARALLEL 1. Now one 3080 server (PID 6692) + the Arc reference (PID 2040).

observations.text: 0-CPU sample of the 3080 llama-server was taken while idle — not evidence of offload either way.
observations.status: superseded by the log + nvidia-smi fit above
